summary: FHLBank Indianapolis filed an 8-K announcing that Chad A. Brandt, age 62, was appointed Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer effective September 1, 2026; he had been SVP-CFO since March 2026 and joined in January 2016 as SVP-Treasurer, and continues as Principal Financial Officer. His annual base salary is $480,000, prorated for 2026, and he remains a Level 1 participant in the 2026 Incentive Compensation Plan. The filing also discloses broader organizational leadership changes. This is an internal promotion and succession event rather than a forced departure, so it is a marginal special-situation classification; no deal terms, advisors, or regulatory clocks apply.
